messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty triggered: onprem-agent heartbeat missing for customer AceroPay (vpc-acc-908). Affected agent: edge-gw-12. Severity: P2. Page to @oncall-infra. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC123456
pd-bot: PagerDuty alert: INC123456 fired -> unacknowledged for 2m. Escalation path: infra -> eng-oncall.
sarah: acked on PD. I'll take first look. -- hitting the bastion now.
maria: looking at control-plane metrics for vpc-acc-908. I see controlplane heartbeats dropped ~14:02 UTC, periodic reconnects before that. No obvious infra-wide blip in eu-west-1.
sarah: on bastion. trying: `ssh -i /secrets/acero_bastion.pem ubuntu@bastion-eu1` then `ssh ubuntu@edge-gw-12`
alex: FYI customer Slack (account team) pinged success@acero earlier about 503s for model calls, started ~14:05 UTC.
jonah: oncall handover in 5m for infra, but I'm available to help. what's the agent version? `cat /etc/redwood-agent/VERSION`
sarah: version 1.4.8. pulling logs: `journalctl -u redwood-agent -n 200 --no-pager | tail -n 80`
maria: logs show repeated TLS handshake errors with controlplane cert: `x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` around 14:01-14:03. Could be cert rotation mismatch.
lee: checking control plane side — controlplane instances show recent cert rotate job at 13:58, rollout to replicas completed at 13:59. Maybe agents didn't pick up new CA bundle.
sarah: trying a quick restart: `sudo systemctl restart redwood-agent`
(10s)
sarah: agent restarted, now waiting for heartbeat...
incident-bot: automated check: heartbeat for edge-gw-12 not seen for 90s. Continuing monitoring.
(30s)
sarah: heartbeat back at 14:07:22 UTC. agent shows connected to control plane vpc-acc-908.
maria: on control plane, I see incoming TLS session from edge-gw-12 established 14:07:23. No auth errors after restart.
alex: customer side: model calls still failing? sales reported some 503s; can we confirm data-plane health for that customer's endpoints?
jonah: running quick smoke: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://acero.private.redwood/api/v1/health` -> 200. Launching few requests...
(20s)
jonah: small sample requests successful. latency back to normal.
sarah: leaving logs & screenshots in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC123456/runbook-notes
maria: root cause hypothesis: controlplane cert rotation completed, but older agent CA bundle didn't trust new intermediate. Restart forced agent to re-read CA store (we push CA via config agent restart triggers config reload). We should update runbook to include `reload-ca` step.
lee: filing follow-up: ticket #OPS-789 to add an automated CA hot-reload in agent and add better alerts for TLS handshake errors.
ops-handoff-bot: Handoff scheduled: oncall shift change in 4m -> @jonah will be primary after 14:10 UTC. Confirmed.
jonah: taking lead. I'll stay on this for the next 30m and monitor for reoccurrence.
sarah: I've notified the account team: short summary + mitigation. Suggest customer customer-facing note: "Intermittent control plane connectivity causing 503s; we've restarted on-prem agent and connectivity restored. Monitoring for 30m."
alex: marking PD incident INC123456 as acknowledged -> resolved in PD after confirmation? I'll wait for 10m of green then resolve.
(10m monitoring period)
jonah: 10m check: heartbeats steady, no TLS errors in logs, no additional 503 reports from customer.
maria: control plane metrics normal, no further cert rotate events.
sarah: agreed safe to resolve.
pd-bot: INC123456 -> resolved by sarah (ack duration 00:08:47).
incident-bot: Incident thread summary: P2 - onprem agent heartbeat missing for edge-gw-12 (AceroPay) caused transient customer 503s. Mitigation: `systemctl restart redwood-agent` on edge-gw-12; heartbeat restored ~120s after restart. Follow-ups: OPS-789 (auto CA reload), runbook update (add `reload-ca` and TLS error detection).
jonah: closing notes: if this recurs ping me directly and I'll escalate to eng-runtime.
sarah: closing channel once PD resolved. :white_check_mark:
